name: RG202619
tagline: Elegant arched design with efficient warmth and convenient storage
description: The Vorel PP5 Eko is a streamlined steel plate fireplace designed for modern living spaces. Characterized by its distinctive arched silhouette and compact footprint, it offers high-efficiency heating while maintaining a minimalist aesthetic. The firebox is lined with heat-retaining bricks to ensure a consistent burn, while the integrated lower compartment provides a dedicated space for log storage, keeping your hearth tidy and functional.
features: Distinctive arched top design for a modern aesthetic
Adjustable primary and secondary air intake sliders
Heat-resistant ceramic glass with an air-wash system
